name: mikrodocs
description: MikroDocs is a minimalist, local-first writing app for Markdown documents.
author: Mikael Vesavuori

scripts.start: npm run build && npx http-server dist -a ${HOST:-127.0.0.1} -p ${PORT:-8000} -c-1
scripts.lint: biome check src tests types scripts esbuild.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check src tests types scripts esbuild.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json --write
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests types scripts esbuild.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run docs:build
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run sbom && npm run scan && npm run licenses && npm run release:assets
scripts.sbom: mkdir -p security && syft file:package-lock.json --output spdx-json > security/sbom.spdx.json
scripts.scan: mkdir -p security && grype sbom:security/sbom.spdx.json -o json > security/grype-report.json
scripts.licenses: mkdir -p security && grant check security/sbom.spdx.json --config .grant.yaml > security/grant-report.txt
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
